frozenMeaning.interpretation: The contract requires the qualified original product authority, not a new public DTO exposing private stop/lease fields. Existing server-side identity validation may supply that authority when its narrowly defined conjunction is actually proven.

validatedAuthorityChain.finding: The original internal receipt must match scope/session/Turn/dispatch/generation and expected operation/lease. Pi terminal receipts require nativeRunning=false/fenced=true stop proof unless a separately specified retirement failure path. Release reconciliation observes exactly the durable hold identity/lease before journal.advanceRelease.

Release disposition is checked against the original Turn resourceLease and generation. An existing releaseHold clears on released or a validated handed-off disposition; generic public null alone therefore does not distinguish these states.

In the cold/no-retention path, release requires the original execution.release running=false, elapsed assignment guard and absence quiet interval, then matching original capacity ticket confirmReleased status/released finishedAt; only then status released is durably written.

Cold execution release also awaits original Project workspace abort; abort requires running=false and fenced=true. Unconfirmed project cleanup throws and remains held, and TrustedPi destroy/release errors do not become success.

A public tool receipt is authorized by original actor/authVersion, saved original Turn and exact checkpoint revision, actual event toolCallId/name and internal dispatch/runtime identity. The bridge target/command ledger is checked against that private original identity even though the public binding omits dispatch/lease.

state terminal alone can represent failed/cancelled tools. For this recipe each original tool must be terminal with completed/success result; unknown/not-admitted/omitted or conflicting receipts cannot qualify. usage remains unknown.

The original Beta slot release branch uses the original admission actor/session/requestKey and matching Turn; unresolved model calls retain exposure. For an admitted completed Turn, current available means no active slot for that ordinary user. Alone it neither supplies the native/raw proof nor identifies a historical dispatch.

timingMeaning.quietMayOverlapAssignmentGuard: Earliest eligible proof is max(release begunAt+360000, absentSince+30000), not necessarily an extra30s after six minutes. Native/capacity checks still must pass.

permittedEvidenceConjunctionForLaterActu: Same ordinary actor/authVersion and original scope/session/requestKey receipt identifies the one actual T1, original runtimeGeneration, completed execution/saved persistence and exact R1 checkpoint. Workspace canonical revision and Session head agree with R1.

Original R1-authorized tool receipts for the actual event toolCallIds/names show both expected commands terminal/completed: mkdir bash exit0 with bounded successful output and write2698B/f050 at the exact skill path. Unknown/failed/cancelled/omitted or foreign-revision results do not qualify.

Fresh normal original-owner snapshot and original-key receipt after the actual release guard show the same T1/R1 still terminal, activeTurn/releaseHold/recoveryHold/resourceWait all null, with no new scope or force-clear action.
Actual cold-mode configuration lineage remains unchanged; this excludes handed-off as the alternative way the public releaseHold can clear for this T1.

Fresh scoped original ordinary Beta capacity is available, and complete current logical/scheduler/exact/Dash physical evidence meets the already accepted at-most-one known basic/max1 running idle VM with container stopped and no extra/unknown active resources.

Combine these source-bound product-authority observations; state explicitly that internal original dispatch/generation/lease and stop proofs were validated by the server and were not publicly exposed or independently read as raw records. Preserve usage/fee uncertainty.

decision.nextAction: Root may collect only the already authorized fresh original product/physical observations and submit them for actual-result acceptance. If the conjunction fails, remains unknown or still held, do not start T2.

limits: This is the evidence threshold interpretation, not acceptance of actual later release or permission to send T2 now. It adds no public raw-field requirement and waives none of the original identity/release conditions.

A saved R1 proves persistence and a terminal fenced native outcome was accepted internally, but the separate assignment/quiet/capacity release is still pending until the original server authority transitions and the conjunction is actually observed.
No new RPC/SQL/log API/SDK observe/hold/force-stop/clear operation is proposed to manufacture missing public fields.
The old public-route inventory remains accurate about what is not exposed. Its raw-field gap cannot be promoted into an unstated requirement to publish private internals.

The product-authority conclusion must be labelled as source-validated inference from server projections plus command and physical authority, not a raw stop/ticket inspection, zero physical VMs, settled usage/cost or global activity proof.
